gloss: to wrap around; to wind around; to coil around

definitions.gloss: to wrap around; to wind around; to coil around
definitions.explanation: To wind or coil something flexible, such as a bandage, rope, or scarf, tightly around an object or body part so that it stays attached.

examples.japanese: {首|くび}にマフラーを{巻|ま}き{付|つ}けた。
examples.english: I wrapped a scarf around my neck.

examples.japanese: {包帯|ほうたい}を{腕|うで}に{巻|ま}き{付|つ}けてください。
examples.english: Please wrap the bandage around your arm.

examples.japanese: ロープを{柱|はしら}にしっかりと{巻|ま}き{付|つ}けた。
examples.english: I wound the rope tightly around the pillar.

examples.japanese: {蛇|へび}が{木|き}の{枝|えだ}に{体|からだ}を{巻|ま}き{付|つ}けていた。
examples.english: A snake had coiled its body around a tree branch.

notes:
A compound verb formed from {巻|ま}く (to wind, to roll) and {付|つ}ける (to attach). Describes the action of wrapping or winding something around an object so that it stays in place.

USAGE:
The pattern is: Thing を Object に{巻|ま}き{付|つ}ける
- を marks what is being wrapped
- に marks what it is wrapped around

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {包帯|ほうたい}を{巻|ま}き{付|つ}ける: to wrap a bandage
- ロープを{巻|ま}き{付|つ}ける: to wind a rope around
- テープを{巻|ま}き{付|つ}ける: to wrap tape around
- マフラーを{巻|ま}き{付|つ}ける: to wrap a scarf around

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {巻|ま}く: to wind, to wrap — more general; does not emphasize attachment
- {巻|ま}き{付|つ}く: to coil around (intransitive) — the thing itself wraps around something
- {絡|から}みつく: to entwine — implies clinging or tangling
